feature_set.leakage_audit: Excluded actual delivery delay, delivery status, transit days, delivered date, return reason, return date, and identifiers.

limitations_and_context.class_prevalence: Base return rate is 12.78% (128 returns / 1,000 test orders).
limitations_and_context.precision_context: Precision is bounded at 17.87% because no pre-dispatch subpopulation exhibits a return probability above ~26% in the absence of post-delivery leakage.
limitations_and_context.operational_value: The model successfully captures 52 out of 128 returns (40.62% recall), providing high actionable utility for targeted pre-shipping size verifications compared to 0 returns for the naive baseline.
